title: River Regulation: What If?
grammar: Recap: *ha … volna*, and a past condition with a result today
goal: I can say what would be different today if something had been done differently (*Ha … volna, ma nem …-na*).
I can talk about river regulation and floodplains (*folyószabályozás*, *fokgazdálkodás*, *vízvisszatartás*).
I can say what could have been avoided.
